{"sql":"WITH us_companies AS (
  SELECT c.symbol
  FROM v_company c
  JOIN v_quarter q ON c.symbol = q.symbol
  WHERE c.market = 'EUA'
  GROUP BY c.symbol
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 12
)
SELECT stats.symbol, 
       q1.period_end as start_date, q1.revenue_usd_b as start_rev,
       q2.period_end as end_date, q2.revenue_usd_b as end_rev
FROM (
  SELECT symbol, MIN(period_end) as start_date, MAX(period_end) as end_date
  FROM v_quarter
  WHERE symbol IN (SELECT symbol FROM us_companies)
  GROUP BY symbol
) stats
JOIN v_quarter q1 ON stats.symbol = q1.symbol AND stats.start_date = q1.period_end
JOIN v_quarter q2 ON stats.symbol = q2.symbol AND stats.end_date = q2.period_end"}

{"sql":"WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    period_end,
    revenue_usd_b,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY period_end ASC) as rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY period_end DESC) as rn_desc
  FROM v_quarter
  WHERE market = 'EUA'
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    symbol,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN period_end END) as first_period,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN period_end END) as last_period,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN revenue_usd_b END) as first_revenue,
    MIN(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN revenue_usd_b END) as last_revenue
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT 
  symbol,
  first_period,
  last_period,
  first_revenue,
  last_revenue,
  (julianday(last_period) - julianday(first_period)) / 365.25 as years,
  POWER(last_revenue / first_revenue, 1.0 / ((julianday(last_period) - julianday(first_period)) / 365.25)) - 1 as cagr
FROM first_last
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked r2 WHERE r2.symbol = first_last.symbol AND r2.rn_asc <= 12) >= 12
ORDER BY cagr DESC"}
